statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ continuous trading remains paused for Labor Day, so there is no live current price path to verify persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Current Tail remains below the block threshold. The main conditional risk checkpoint is the scheduled 22:00 UTC futures reopen and the first hours of post-reopen price discovery.
headline: Holiday pause keeps Tail at WATCH ahead of the futures reopen
body: Tail is capped by the absence of live NQ structure during the Labor Day pause. Reuters reports Brent at $97.31 after a $98.06 session high amid renewed U.S.-Iran/Hormuz escalation, which keeps Stress extreme. Shared Finviz context is stale beyond the 90-minute support window and is not used as current evidence.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, published ChatGPT assessments kept Stress at 100 and dominant mode at event/whipsaw. Tail ranged from 18 to 24, fell to LOW during part of the holiday session, and returned to WATCH as the trading pause removed live price-path confirmation.
outlookSummary: The highest conditional Tail is concentrated around the 22:00 UTC futures reopen, peaking at 32 in the first full post-reopen hour only if a directional gap resists repair and failed retracements repeat. Risk returns toward WATCH if price discovery becomes two-sided. Consumer Credit is the next verified U.S. data checkpoint.
